service.description: The scope service of Marketing's form purposes (mantle.party.FormPurpose scopeServiceName): the organizations of the caller's Marketing scope (every internal one for a holder of MARKETING_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS or a system administrator), none for a caller who reads nothing of Marketing.

A new publication of a Marketing form (formId) or a change of one (publicationId, at expectedRevision), by a content author (MARKETING_CONTENT_EDIT) of the form's organization: the access kind its purpose admits, the repeat policy, the site (a published one whose marketing mount targets the organization: SITE_INVALID), the campaign (an open one of the organization, its context record and CampaignAssociation; CAMPAIGN_CLOSED, CAMPAIGN_FIXED), the list a respondent may choose to subscribe to (a Marketing list of the organization), the closing date and the page's words; the Commons rules of mantle.party.FormPublicationServices.store#Publication apply. It opens by publish#Publication.

A publication opens at fromDate (now or later) once its readiness holds (NOT_READY naming what is missing: the form's questions published, a site whose Marketing pages serve the organization, and for invitations a campaign), by a content author of its organization at the revision read.

The Marketing publications of the caller's scope (a Marketing reader), of one form or campaign when named, newest first (at most 200): each one's form, purpose, access, repeat policy, site, campaign, subscription choice, state, dates, invitation and answer counts and public page.

One Marketing publication of the caller's scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise), or with formId alone what a new publication of that form offers: its view, its readiness, its invitation sends with their invited and answered counts, the access kinds, sites, campaigns and lists to choose from, and what the caller may do (canEdit, canPublish, canClose, canInvite).

An invitation send of a publication of invited recipients (PUBLICATION_NOT_OFFERED, PUBLICATION_CLOSED; a campaign and a site first: CAMPAIGN_REQUIRED, NOT_READY), by a send author (MARKETING_SEND_EDIT): a draft CampaignSend of the publication's campaign to a topic and audience (mantle.marketing.CampaignSendServices.create#Send's rules) that names the publication. Its preparation, approval, release and dispatch are the send's own, so an invitation reaches only a recipient the promotional checks admit; each message carries the recipient's own invitation link, made at each attempt.

A Marketing form's responses for a reader of its purpose (MARKETING_AUDIENCE_VIEW or MARKETING_REPORT_VIEW) and organization: only those submitted to a Marketing publication of the scope (one publication's when named), newest first (at most 200), each with its publication, date, respondent (named for an audience reader only, else "A respondent"; anonymous when none was verified), how it came (invitation, signed in, public page) and score; the form and publication choices and the summary (get#ResponseStats). A case's feedback on any form is never among them.

One response submitted to a Marketing publication of the caller's scope, for a reader of its purpose, with the form as of its submission (each answer with its question and option text then), its publication, respondent (as find#Responses names one), how it came and score. Any other response (a case's feedback, one of no Marketing publication, another organization's) is RECORD_UNAVAILABLE.

The summary of a Marketing form's responses (one publication's when named) for a reader of its purpose: invited, delivered and answered, the response rate, the average score of the answered scored questions with the answered count and maximum apart (an unscored or unanswered question left out), and each choice's answers by option, each response read with the form of its date; truncated past 5,000 responses.

The lead rules of the caller's scope for a content author or the Marketing administrator (MARKETING_CONTENT_EDIT or MARKETING_CONFIGURE; PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise), current ones unless includeEnded, of one organization, lead form publication or campaign when named, newest first (at most 200): each one's lead form, campaign, trigger, team, Sales source, mapping, condition, dates and state, with its handed-off, failed and waiting counts.

One lead rule of the caller's scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE otherwise), or with publicationId alone the current rule or what a new one of that lead form offers, or with neither the lead form publications a new rule may route (not closed, none current): the rule's view, its publication, the form's questions to map, the organization's current sales teams and offered sources, its counts and recent captures (a Sales lead named only to a caller who opens it in Sales), and whether the caller may change it.

A new lead rule of a lead form's publication (publicationId; RULE_EXISTS when it has a current one), a change of a current rule (leadRuleId at expectedRevision: a new rule from now replacing it, REVISION_CHANGED, RULE_ENDED), or its end (end), by a content author (MARKETING_CONTENT_EDIT) of the publication's organization: the team (a current sales team of the organization, TEAM_UNAVAILABLE; chosen or changed only by a holder of SALES_TEAM_MANAGE in the organization, TEAM_PERMISSION, else the rule's own or Sales' default team; empty hands each lead to Sales' default team, TEAM_REQUIRED when there is none: the user's call of Nov 14, 2026), the Sales source (offered to the organization, SOURCE_INVALID), the questions mapped to the inquiry's name, organization, email and phone (at least one, MAPPING_REQUIRED) and to its notes, an optional condition on one answer (CONDITION_INVALID), each a customer-visible question of the form (FIELD_UNKNOWN), and the notice the page shows. A closed lead form takes no new rule (PUBLICATION_CLOSED).

What a lead rule (saved, or the values given for a new one of a publication) would hand to Sales for a sample answer, for a reader of the rules: the publication's latest answer (or the one named) for an audience reader (MARKETING_AUDIENCE_VIEW), else an answer made of the questions; the mapped name, organization, email, phone, lead name and notes, whether the condition lets it through, the queue, the source, the campaign, verification, the duplicate policy and a capture already made of that answer. Changes nothing and asks nothing of Sales.

The captures of a lead rule, a campaign or a lead form publication of the caller's scope (a Marketing reader), of one state when named, newest first (at most 200): state, when captured and handed off, attempts, the reason of a failure and when it is tried again, new or joined lead, and the Sales lead only for a caller who opens it in Sales. No answer is shown.

The handoff counts of a campaign, a lead rule or a lead form publication of the caller's scope, for any Marketing reader (MARKETING_VIEW alone gives these and no pipeline): captured, new leads, joined open leads, waiting, failed and not handed off, from Marketing's own capture rows (F66).

ReprocessCapture (design §10): the failed or waiting captures named (leadCaptureIds, at most 200), or a rule's failed ones, of the caller's scope handed to Sales again with the reason (REASON_REQUIRED), by a content author (MARKETING_CONTENT_EDIT); each in its own transaction under its own operation key, so a capture Sales already took answers its first lead; a capture handed off or skipped is left as it is, another organization's is not available.

The capture job (run_MarketingLeadCaptures; design §15.3 Capture handoff), as the system: each lead rule's accepted answers of the last 30 days with no capture captured once, then the waiting captures and the failed ones whose time has come handed to Sales, each in a transaction of its own; one that fails is logged and the next goes on.

Internal (after a lead form's answer commits, and the capture job), in a transaction of its own, as the system: an accepted submission of a lead form captured once by the rule in effect when it was submitted (one capture per rule and submission) and handed to Sales; an answer of another purpose, or with no rule, is left alone.

Internal (capture#FormSubmission, the capture job, process#LeadCaptures), in a transaction of its own: one capture under its lock handed to Sales' mantle.sales.OpportunityServices.store#LeadIntake as the system, in Sales' own transaction, under the capture's operation key, with values only from Marketing's records (the publication's organization and campaign, the rule's team and source and mapped published answers, Marketing's own verification); handed off with the lead made or joined, skipped when the rule's condition is not met, or failed with the reason and the next try. A capture handed off or skipped answers as it is.
